adopter_lexicon_evidence.transport and accessibility reviewer rol: The package-local responsibility-transfer contract names this role for accessible routes, curb space and protected public access.
adopter_lexicon_evidence.community liaison and accessibility role: The package-local public-baseline contract names the community and accessibility interface for ordinary daily access and human service.
adopter_lexicon_evidence.rail and bus operations role: The package-local responsibility-transfer contract names this role for dated headways, station capacity and transfer observations.
adopter_lexicon_evidence.independent safety and privacy review ro: The package-local responsibility-transfer contract names independent review for safety, accessibility, privacy and equity burden.

adoption.scope_zh: 只采用本包已公开的三处接口、人工替代、责任角色和公共基线阶段字段做互操作对照；不采用外部包的叙事、几何或数据，不新增仓库硬门禁、正式评分项、服务覆盖或现场成效主张。
adoption.scope_en: This maps already-public interface, human-alternative, role and public-baseline phase fields for interoperability only. It adopts no external package narrative, geometry or data, and adds no repository hard gate, formal score item, service coverage or field-outcome claim.

ai_off_path.zh: 纸面登记、现场引导和公开公共交通路线可独立承接到岗与装卸，不依赖 App。
ai_off_path.en: Paper registration, on-site wayfinding and the published public-transport route can independently receive arrival and loading requests without an app.

ai_off_path.zh: 步入、电话、纸面、公共交通和人工服务台可完成同一项日常到达，不要求企业账号。
ai_off_path.en: Walking, telephone, paper, public transport and a staffed service desk can complete the same daily-access task without an enterprise account.
